notes.title: 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 is out on Steam & Steam Deck 🔥
notes.content:
𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 is out on Steam and supporting Steam Deck 🔥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1534660/BURN/

Thanks for playing and revewing BURN everyone.

We made 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 to make an impact and we're so glad people are enjoying and finding it meaningful.

Here's a couple of our favourite reviews:

“A special ride and unquestionably a work of art” - madskdz

“BURN’s art and audio heighten the experience” - Press Jump to Start

Please help us share the news and leave a Steam review.

You can play 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 in two different versions:

1. BURN - $5.99 USD (
2. BURN - Deluxe Edition ( BURN, Art Book and Screenplay ) - $9.99 USD

We also have a bundle with our debut, STONE ːsteamhappyː

You can get STONE - Bloody Legend ( STONE, Art Book and Screenplay ) and  and BURN - Deluxe Edition for $20 USD ( Save $5 USD ).

Please feel free to reach out for any issues on our Discussion board if you need anything and enjoy.

𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 is a short and replayable visual novel, where you play Nina BURN, the biggest pop star in the world at the turning point of her career. Will you change pop music? Will you become a monster?

𝖄𝖔𝖚 𝖜𝖎𝖑𝖑 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹.

𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 is a story game everyone can finish at least once as the first ending arrives in 15 minutes and it is Convict Games’ most interactive story to date out now on Steam.

PLAY 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 NOW.
